---
name: Proposal
about: Propose an improvement to a project, shared resource, or practice.
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Need and intended outcome

What needs to improve, who would benefit, and what would success look like?

## Affected projects or communities

List the relevant repositories, resources, and people or groups who should review the proposal.

## Proposed approach

Describe the change and any alternatives or tradeoffs.

## Evidence and context

Link relevant sources, earlier discussions, or examples. Distinguish confirmed information from assumptions.

## Scope and completion criteria

Describe the boundaries and concrete evidence that the work is complete.

## Dependencies and decisions

Identify required coordination, proposed responsibilities, and any funding, access, or publication decisions. Record unresolved questions.
